# dsh-plugin-pi-bridge

> Bridge Pi's skills and configuration into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — zero migration.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-pi-bridge)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-pi-bridge)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile your-profile add dsh-plugin-pi-bridge
```

## What it does

Reads Pi's skill files and injects them into the dsh system prompt as available skills.

Works out of the box. Optional config:
